boston-dynamics-atlas.author: Lance Ulanoff
boston-dynamics-atlas.summary: A TechRadar writer who watched the first public Atlas demo at CES 2026 judged it the standout robot of the show.

canvas-1200cx.summary: Webcor's innovation lead says the Canvas drywall finishing robot's work exceeded expectations and helps deliver faster and more reliably, though humans still do final touch-ups.
canvas-1200cx.quote: This has increased our ability to deliver faster and more reliably,

canvas-1200cx.quote: I am just blown away by the quality. The Level 5 is pretty phenomenal.

cobod-bod2.quote: COBOD is testing out different enclosures, and investigating how cold it can be for the printer to still work.

construction-robotics-sam.quote: I don't think it's a large cost reducer, but it could be a scheduling reducer.

construction-robotics-sam.summary: MIT Technology Review reported SAM works best on large flat walls but can handle some detail work.
construction-robotics-sam.quote: In its current iteration, the system is best suited to work on large swaths of flat walls, most commonly found in projects for universities, hospitals, and other large sites.

deep-robotics-lite3.quote: I'm looking for documentation on movement commands for basic locomotion.

dewalt-dale.author: Kenny Koehler

dusty-robotics-fieldprinter-2.quote: Gegenüber einem geschätzten manuellen Ablauf sank der Arbeitsaufwand um 68 %. Die Dauer der Markierungsarbeiten verkürzte sich um 18 %.

dusty-robotics-fieldprinter-2.author: Lachmi Khemlani

q-bot-underfloor-insulation-robot.author: Jeremy Williams

teleo-supervised-autonomy.author: Scott Lyons (Tomahawk Construction), quoted
